title: Borderlands 2
provenance: Reported by Noodle9987 (highball-db#1243, 2026-11-15), Apple A18 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r27, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 20 minutes: on a MacBook Neo, frame drops at the highest resolution, in an environment set up for Counter-Strike 2, whose dxvk.conf section is for csgo.exe only, with ddraw=n,b. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Gearbox's 2012 shooter, a 32-bit Direct3D 9 game. Reported playable on a MacBook Neo (Apple A18 Pro) with DXMT on the Wine 11 engine r27 over 20 minutes, with frame drops at the highest resolution. On that engine DXMT mode leaves Direct3D 9 to Wine's own. Steam lists a Mac version as well, an older port not checked here.

knownIssues.symptom: Frame drops at the highest resolution (MacBook Neo, Wine 11 r27, DXMT, highball-db#1243)
